character: Traditional Haute-Savoie market town at the valley floor. Original alpine charm — church, square, stone buildings. Full year-round town with supermarket, shops, schools. Prodains cable car up to Avoriaz (1,800m). Lively weekly market. Good-value compared to Avoriaz.
dining: L'Etale (Michelin-starred). La Perdrix. La Grange aux Fées. Le Petit Écossais. Numerous village restaurants from Turkish to Savoyard.
shopping: Full town — supermarkets (Carrefour, Spar), bakeries, butchers, fromagerie, sports shops, fashion, pharmacy, post office. Weekly market (Saturday).
apres_scene: Le Petit Écossais (pub). L'Etale. Bars near the church square. Le Clin d'Oeil. Less intense than Avoriaz but good choice.
activities_nearby: Prodains cable car to Avoriaz/PDS (650km). Ice rink. Bowling. Cinema. Aquariaz in Avoriaz. Paragliding. Hiking. Lake Montriond.
